test_GTestColorTest: test the GTestColorTest class to verify Google Test color detection logic for various terminal types
run_SetEnvVar: run SetEnvVar to set or unset an environment variable by name with a given value
run_UsesColor: run UsesColor to check if gtest_color_test_ outputs color for a given TERM and flag combination
test_testNoEnvVarNoFlag: test the testNoEnvVarNoFlag method to verify color behavior when neither GTEST_COLOR env var nor gtest_color flag is set
test_testAliasesOfYesAndNo: test the testAliasesOfYesAndNo method to verify yes/no aliases like true, false, 1, 0 for gtest_color flag
